research_question: Can G-LMDM (Graph-Conditioned Logic-Regularized Masked Discrete Model) synthesize Zelda-like dungeons from unseen mission graphs while cleanly attributing raw neural validity, symbolic repair burden, formal StateSpaceAStar proofs, and bounded P-CBS diagnostics?
confirmatory_research_question: On held-out Dungeon-9 mission graphs, do causal Block III GraphGPS+RRWP conditioning, absorbing-state discrete masked synthesis on 16x11 tile tokens, and direct 16x11 Soft Bellman-Ford LogicNet supervision jointly increase pre-repair oracle solvability and reduce symbolic repair burden (repair_rate, tiles_repaired_mean) relative to unconditioned, continuous VQ-VAE latent diffusion/flow, and external symbolic baselines at matched diversity and lower parameter cost?

RG1.title: (FG1) Macro-to-Micro Semantic-Geometric Disconnect in Hierarchical Zelda Generation
RG1.summary: Two-stage Zelda pipelines (Dormans 2010; Summerville et al. 2015; Lavender & Thompson 2016; Gutierrez & Schrum 2020 Graph-GAN) synthesize rooms unconditionally or via PCA without causal boundary/neighbor conditioning or global relative random-walk positional encodings (RRWP, Ma et al. 2023), forcing destructive post-hoc door carving and rejection sampling.

RG2.title: (FG2) Continuous-Latent Bottleneck and Rarity Erasure in Small-Data Categorical Tile Grids
RG2.summary: On small, severely imbalanced categorical dungeon corpora (VGLC: 349 Dungeon 1-8 train rooms, 217 unique 16x11 grids, 43 unique 12x7 structural interiors; 88.60% WALL+FLOOR vs. 0.68% ENEMY and 0.05% STAIR), continuous latent diffusion (VQ-VAE + UNet/DiT, van den Oord et al. 2017; Schrum et al. 2025) introduces tokenization distortion, parameter bloat (47.13M UNet[1,2] / 22.44M DiT+Flow), argmax rarity erasure, and low raw playability (12-27%), whereas absorbing-state discrete masked synthesis (Austin et al. 2021 D3PM; Chang et al. 2022 MaskGIT; Inoue et al. 2023 LayoutDM; Sahoo et al. 2024 MDLM) operates natively on 16x11 tokens (3.58M train / 3.36M inference) and supports exact t=0 boundary clamping.

RG3.title: (FG3) Traversability-Blind Likelihood Training and Unattributed Post-Hoc Repair
RG3.summary: Standard categorical cross-entropy treats single-tile corridor cut-sets (1/176 = 0.57%) identically to interior decoration, yielding fragile raw layouts (24.3% pre-repair GAN validity before MILP repair, Zhang et al. 2020; Cooper 2022/2023). Differentiable planning and semantic losses (Tamar et al. 2016 VIN; Xu et al. 2018) mitigate this only when applied directly to discrete 16x11 tile logits rather than through lossy continuous decoders, and when edit burden (repair_rate, tiles_repaired_mean) is attributed cleanly across raw -> constrained -> repaired -> compiled stages.

RG4.title: (FG4) Dungeon-Split Leakage, External Baseline Deficit, and Proxy-vs-Oracle Conflation
RG4.summary: PCG evaluation audits (Summerville et al. 2016; Holmgard et al. 2018; Withington et al. 2024; Khalifa et al. 2025) document that random room splits across the 9 Zelda dungeons leak dungeon style, internal-only ablations omit external symbolic baselines (Random, WFC, Grammar-only), dependent multi-fold averages produce pseudoreplicated intervals, and bounded-agent personas (P-CBS) cannot substitute for exact StateSpaceAStar proofs or human-subject studies.

PS1.title: Causal Multi-Scale Conditioning Deficit in Two-Stage Dungeon Synthesis
PS1.summary: Without causal Block III mission-role embeddings, GraphGPS+RRWP topological encodings, directional neighbor-map features, and incident doorway boundary signals (G vs. N and No-RRWP), room generators break inter-room door continuity and key-lock role alignment prior to repair.

PS2.title: Continuous Latent Compression Pathology vs. Discrete Token Generation on 43 Unique Interiors
PS2.summary: Applying 17.37M VQ-VAE + 26.33M UNet[1,2] (47.13M total) or DiT+Flow (22.44M total) to 349 training rooms (217 unique 16x11 grids, 43 unique 12x7 structural interiors) compounds tokenization distortion and rarity erasure (<0.7% ENEMY/STAIR), whereas discrete absorbing-state G-LMDM (3.58M train / 3.36M inference) avoids continuous decoding errors and permits exact token boundary clamping.

PS3.title: Traversability-Blind Objective and Unattributed Repair Burden
PS3.summary: Tokenwise cross-entropy alone fails to preserve 1-tile corridors and resource-ordered routes, while reporting only post-repair WFC/BFS outputs masks raw neural failure behind deterministic repair edits (repair_rate, tiles_repaired_mean).

PS4.title: Dungeon-Level Leakage, Omitted External Baselines, and Proof-Proxy Conflation
PS4.summary: Non-holdout room splits, omitted external symbolic baselines (Random, WFC, Grammar-only), dependent multi-fold pooling without within-graph pairing, and equating bounded-rational P-CBS trajectories with formal StateSpaceAStar solvability proofs invalidate empirical claims.

RO1.summary: Isolate G-LMDM's causal Block III GraphGPS + RRWP + directional neighbor/boundary conditioner (G) against unconditioned/neighbor-only (N) and non-RRWP graph encoders (No-RRWP) on unseen mission graphs.

RO2.summary: Conduct matched-split, 4 GB GPU-budget comparisons between discrete absorbing-state G-LMDM (MaskedRoom, 3.58M train / 3.36M inference) and continuous latent baselines (VQ-VAE + UNet[1,2] 47.13M, DiT+Flow 22.44M) on rare-tile preservation, pre-repair validity, and generation latency.

RO3.summary: Couple differentiable Soft Bellman-Ford LogicNet supervision directly onto G-LMDM's 16x11 tile logits (G-L/G-LG vs. G and inference-only guidance) and report full Schema 2.0 4-stage attribution (raw -> constrained -> repaired -> compiled).

RO4.summary: Enforce strict Dungeon-9 holdout (Dungeons 1-8 train vs. unseen Dungeon 9 test), descriptive LODO sensitivity checks, paired non-parametric Holm-corrected comparisons against external symbolic baselines (Random, WFC, Grammar-only), and strict separation between hard StateSpaceAStar proofs and bounded P-CBS diagnostics.

RQ1.question: Relative to unconditioned/neighbor-only (N) and non-RRWP graph encoders (No-RRWP), does causal Block III GraphGPS+RRWP conditioning (G) improve pre-repair door alignment, boundary consistency, and mission-role adherence on held-out Dungeon-9 graphs?

RQ2.question: On the small-data VGLC 16x11 corpus (349 train rooms, 43 unique 12x7 interiors), does discrete absorbing-state G-LMDM preserve rare gameplay tiles (<0.7% ENEMY/STAIR) and achieve higher pre-repair validity at lower parameter/latency cost than continuous VQ-VAE + UNet[1,2] and DiT+Flow baselines?

RQ3.question: Holding GraphGPS+RRWP conditioning (G) fixed, does direct 16x11 differentiable Soft Bellman-Ford LogicNet supervision (G-LG) raise pre-repair oracle solvability and reduce repair_rate and tiles_repaired_mean across raw -> constrained -> repaired -> compiled stages without diversity collapse?

RQ4.question: Under held-out Dungeon-9 evaluation, external symbolic baselines (Random, WFC, Grammar-only), paired non-parametric inference, and explicit separation of StateSpaceAStar proofs from bounded P-CBS diagnostics, do G-LMDM improvements generalize to unseen dungeon topologies without human-likeness overclaiming?

H1.statement: Causal Block III GraphGPS+RRWP conditioning (G) significantly improves pre-repair door alignment, boundary match accuracy, and mission-role consistency over N and No-RRWP on unseen Dungeon-9 mission graphs.
H1.null_rule: If No-RRWP or N matches G on boundary/role consistency within paired uncertainty intervals, retain the simpler conditioner and document topological redundancy.

H2.statement: Absorbing-state discrete G-LMDM achieves higher rare-tile recall and pre-repair room validity with an order-of-magnitude smaller footprint (3.58M train / 3.36M inference vs. 47.13M UNet[1,2] and 22.44M DiT+Flow) and lower sampling latency on a 4 GB GPU.
H2.null_rule: If continuous VQ-VAE + UNet[1,2] or DiT+Flow surpasses discrete G-LMDM on raw dungeon-scale structural coherence or solvability, document the discrete-continuous Pareto trade-off rather than hiding continuous baselines.

H3.statement: Direct 16x11 training-time Soft Bellman-Ford LogicNet supervision (G-LG) increases raw oracle solvability and reduces symbolic repair_rate and tiles_repaired_mean relative to G and inference-only gradient guidance at comparable diversity.
H3.null_rule: If G-LG reduces diversity or fails to outperform G and inference-only guidance on repair_rate, report the precision-diversity trade-off explicitly.

H4.statement: Within-identity Dungeon-9 paired Holm-corrected tests, descriptive LODO sensitivity checks, external symbolic baselines (Random, WFC, Grammar-only), and Block I topology bounds preserve G-LMDM's pre-repair validity and lower repair burden while keeping hard StateSpaceAStar solvability distinct from P-CBS behavioral diagnostics.

publishable_direction.primary: G-LMDM: graph-conditioned, logic-regularized discrete masked neuro-symbolic PCG framework with attributed 4-stage repair verification

proposed_method_blocks: Block IV G-LMDM discrete masked generator (and UNet/DiT continuous comparators)
Block V differentiable Soft Bellman-Ford LogicNet diagnostics/supervision
Block VII hard StateSpaceAStar oracle and bounded P-CBS diagnostics

data_card.leakage_policy: Dungeon 9 (101 room instances across Quest 1 and Quest 2) is held out from training and model selection.
data_card.augmentation_policy: Document exact augmentation commands before use.

artifacts.name: vqvae
artifacts.notes: Continuous baseline tokenizer checkpoint (for UNet/DiT comparators); must not be a diffusion bundle.

artifacts.name: diffusion
artifacts.notes: Continuous latent UNet/DiT comparator checkpoint trained on Dungeon 1-8 and paired with vqvae above.

artifacts.name: masked_room
artifacts.notes: Canonical G-LMDM discrete masked generator checkpoint (condition_gnn_type=gps, logic_net_enabled=true, alpha_logic=0.1) trained on Dungeon 1-8.

metric_contract.raw_vs_repaired_policy: Raw, constrained, repaired, and compiled stage oracle/P-CBS rates must be reported separately.
metric_contract.timeout_policy: Timeout, unsolved, and invalid-input outcomes are separate labels.

human_calibration.required_for_human_claims: Consent-marked human telemetry plus persona calibration.
